adham.docHTML:
A
Petly Team Veterinary Doctor

Veterinary Doctor

Dr. Adham

Provides attentive veterinary care with a calm bedside manner and clear communication for families.

Back to team

Family Reviews

What pet owners say about Dr. Adham

SI

I had a wonderful experience at Petly. The staff are incredibly caring, professional, and attentive to every detail. A special thanks to Dr. Raed, Dr. Adham, Dina, and Mais for their kindness and dedication — they truly went above and beyond to make sure my pet received the best care. Their compassion and expertise made me feel completely at ease, and I'm very grateful for the excellent service. Highly recommended!

Sawsan Istaitiea Google

raed.docHTML:
R
Petly Team Veterinary Doctor

Veterinary Doctor

Dr. Raed

Brings balanced clinical judgment and reassuring guidance that helps owners feel supported at every step.

Back to team

Family Reviews

What pet owners say about Dr. Raed

IV

Petly staff has been absolutely amazing! They took wonderful care of my cat, saved her life, and followed her diet instructions carefully. The entire team went above and beyond to make sure she was healthy and ready to travel. A special thank you to Dr. Raed for his empathetic and caring approach, and to the lovely ladies at the reception who helped ensure all the travel paperwork and health certificates were in order — you're all truly awesome, thank you for everything! ❤️

Imad Vodislav Google

yara.docHTML:
Y
Petly Team Veterinary Doctor

Veterinary Doctor

Dr. Yara

Combines compassionate care with practical treatment planning so families leave with confidence and clarity.

Back to team

Family Reviews

What pet owners say about Dr. Yara

J

Petly has been amazing. They saved my puppy's life when she was fighting a deadly virus. The staff went above and beyond and even went out of their way to make sure she was constantly monitored and well taken care of. From the moment we walked in, the team showed compassion, professionalism, and dedication. They kept me updated, answered all my endless questions, and treated my puppy with so much care and attention during a very stressful time. A special thank you to Dr. Yara and Dr. Abdelrahman for their expertise, kindness, and commitment.

Joud
